sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 284B total parameters and 13B activated parameters, supporting 1M-token context and 384K max output. It handles text and image inputs and is optimized for fast inference and high-throughput workloads including coding, chat, and agent systems.

sources.snippet: Technical Report 👁️ Introduction DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance-cost Pareto frontier ...

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash by DeepSeek | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is DeepSeek's multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model: 552 billion parameters with 8B active per token during prefill and 16B during decode, native image and text input, and a one-million-token context window built for input-heavy agentic workloads.
